recorded_from: cpp TS2Python_TestHarness.exe --mode smoke (the two EL_Init announcements only)
derivation: Written by applying contract/wire.md to the recorded frames by hand.
NOT generated by running any binding.
These frames are NOT data points and must not be decoded as such:
topic     = __ts2py__, fixed. The topic IS the discriminator -- no
`kind` field was added and the point frame is unchanged.
symbol / category / bar_type / bar_interval = EL's own words for the
chart, verbatim, exactly as the point frame carries them.
proto     = 2. The point frame did not change, so the wire version did
not either; what changed is the DLL ABI (EL_DllVersion 3).
seq       = the control topic's OWN counter, independent of every
symbol's. Both frames here are from one session, so it
runs 1, 2.
sid       = the same publisher session id the point frames carry.
ts        = DLL receive clock when EL_Init was called. There is no
ts_str: a hello is not a bar and has no bar time.
A binding must NOT surface these as market events. The required
behaviour is in wire.md 'hello -- chart 宣告 frame': subscribe to the
control topic unconditionally, report a subscribed chart as now
receiving, WARN on one that is not subscribed, and never let a
malformed announcement end the stream.
sid and ts are per-run and were read from this recording.
